conventions.uint64_encoding: Exact decimal strings; optional 0x-prefixed hexadecimal. Counts/indices are JSON integers.
conventions.validation: Execution after extension N validates N and provides data used in extension N+1.
conventions.other_channel_views: Readout selections only; actual insertions and seeding are recorded separately.

snapshot_granularity.native_execution: All eight cells before seeding, after seeding and after execution.
snapshot_granularity.captured_core: All eight cells after each encoded input value; intermediate trace is reference execution reconciled with native final output.

sources.channel_identity: Recorded ranked spectral stripes; frequency metadata is retained per source value.
